title: Tavron at Food Pro 2023
summary: Our team met visitors at the Tavron Engineers stand at Food Pro 2023.

image.alt: The Tavron Engineers team at the Food Pro 2023 exhibition stand

body: The Tavron Engineers team was at Food Pro 2023, meeting visitors at our stand and talking through process equipment and turnkey plants for dairy and food processing.
There are more photos from the stand in our LinkedIn post.

title: March 2022 dispatches: a 15 KL silo, storage tanks and a butter churn
summary: Equipment that left our Chennai factory in March 2022, from a 500 L bulk milk cooler to a 15 KL vertical milk silo.

image.alt: A 15 KL milk silo and a 3 KL jacketed tank strapped to a flatbed truck at night, ready to leave the Tavron factory

body: Finished equipment leaves our factory at Manali New Town, Chennai, by road. In March 2022 that included milk storage, heat transfer, dairy and powder-handling equipment.
The dispatch sheet has a photo of each item.

list.title: What left the factory
items: 15 KL vertical milk silo and 3 KL jacketed tank

title: February 2022 dispatches: a 20 KL silo, storage tanks and CIP tanks
summary: Equipment that left our Chennai factory in February 2022, led by a 20 KL vertical milk silo lifted out by crane.

image.alt: A crane lifting a 20 KL vertical milk silo outside the Tavron Engineers factory

body: In February 2022 a 20 KL vertical milk silo was lifted out of our factory at Manali New Town, Chennai, by crane, along with milk storage tanks, CIP tanks and process equipment.
The dispatch sheet has a photo of each item.

list.title: What left the factory
items: 10 KL and 15 KL double-compartment horizontal milk storage tanks
Milk can trip saver, tubular heater and 1 HP pump
1,000 L dump tank, 600 L weigh bowl and 5 KL vertical milk storage tank
500 L overhead tank, 100 L dosing tank, flush tank and CIP tank
6 KL storage tank, hot water tank and caustic tank
